status: Explicit conditional benchmark completion; not historical identification
bank_population: Z.1 L.110 private depository institutions, including credit unions and US-affiliated-area banks
units: USD millions; normalization allocations rounded to nearest million, ties to even
debt_B: Treasury marketable plus nonmarketable securities. Holder marketable positions normalized to issuer face total with a common price factor. Nonmarketable Treasury securities assigned to nonbank H. Budget-agency and GSE issuer debt is in J, not Treasury B.
debt_L: Z.1 L.214 loan instrument total minus federal-government loan liabilities (nonmarketable Treasuries already in B), private-DI other-loan funding, Treasury-owned loans and monetary-authority facility loans. All remaining instruments owed by nonbank H are included regardless of bank origination; no q/turnover estimator. Agency look-through redistributes this existing underlying principal between H, banks and Fed; it does not add principal. Treasury loan assets and Fed facility loans remain outside this particular L perimeter.
debt_J: Selected eligible other claims: bank/Fed positions classified below, plus nonbank open-market paper, municipal/corporate/foreign bonds and the selected agency-security layer. Nonbank bank-issued securities are excluded from J_H because they are represented as Q_B^H. J-inclusive debt means exactly D+J_H+J_B+J_F, not all worldwide legal obligations.

valuation.treasury: Uniform market-to-face factor FL313161105 / FL893061105 applied to bank and Fed Treasury holdings; nonbank is the remaining face principal. An explicit projection assumption, not observed holder-specific prices.
valuation.agency: Uniform issuer-face / holder-market factor FL893161705 / FL893061705. Fed observed MBS and bank observed US-chartered MBS components receive that same factor.
valuation.other_J: Published balance/market measures retained as projected current repayment balances. No claim these equal instrument-specific legal face values. A complete face-valued J series remains unobserved.
valuation.equity: Source financial assets plus annual measured nonfinancial assets minus financial liabilities, bridged to published equity instruments plus IMA net worth, then adjusted for explicit consolidation/valuation projections. Not FDIC capital and not regulatory capital.
valuation.2008: No usable amortized-security observation; use source-valued net assets with explicit Treasury/agency normalization. Do not extrapolate the 2020 remainder.

agency_split.observed_US_bank_MBS: L.111 sum LM763061805 + LM763061503 + LM763061603 + LM763061403; checked against total agency less LM763061795
agency_split.other_bank_subsectors: Remaining L.110 agency holdings after the US-chartered subtotal. Three allocations: no MBS, same MBS share as observed US-chartered banks, all MBS.
agency_split.underlying_pool_principal: L.126 FL413065005 plus L.125 securitized mortgages FL403065195 + FL403065495. Not all GSE mortgages; not the sum of mortgages and financing securities.
agency_split.government_agency_holdings: Assigned to agency issuer debt, not MBS, for this conditional completion; residual holder allocations are checked feasible.
agency_split.guarantee_layer: Agency look-through suppresses the agency MBS financing/guarantee layer from J and counts underlying mortgage principal once in L. Security-outside-D retains that layer in J and leaves underlying loans in H. These are distinct representations, not confidence bounds.
agency_split.private_MBS: Private MBS/CMOs in corporate/foreign bonds remain J. This sensitivity is specifically agency-MBS look-through, not a claim of complete look-through of every private structured security.

bank_assets.N_B: Measured nonfinancial assets plus corporate equities, direct-investment equity, miscellaneous other equity and mutual-fund shares, less nontransferable Federal Reserve stock
bank_assets.J_B: External-foreign-bank claims; FHLB deposits; bank repo/fed-funds assets; open-market paper; municipals; corporate/foreign bonds; direct-investment debt; life-insurance reserves; retained agency issuer/security layer
bank_assets.X_B_res: Published miscellaneous bank assets, grossed negative Fed float counterpart, and nontransferable Federal Reserve stock
bank_assets.eligibility: Conversion/settlement at projected balances is a model policy, not a finding about Fed legal purchase powers. No nonbank non-debt assets are monetized.

bank_funding.Q_B_H: Foreign interbank borrowing outside selected bank perimeter, repo/fed funds, debt securities, other loans, direct-investment debt
bank_funding.Q_B_res: Federal bank deposits, taxes payable, miscellaneous bank liabilities; held fixed
bank_funding.additional_internal_crossholdings: Zero intra-bank repo and security positions beyond explicitly mapped L.202 interbank claims. Feasible marginal-allocation assumption, not an observed bilateral matrix. It is not bounded by the two small discrepancy sensitivities.

fed.N_F: Annual measured nonfinancial assets plus corporate equities
fed.J_F: Other reserve deposits, swaps, repo assets, foreign securities, nonbank facility credit and selected agency layer
fed.X_F_res: Coin, gold and SDR certificates, unidentified miscellaneous assets, with the named rounding/remainder correction; locked
fed.Q_H: GSE, other-financial and foreign deposits plus reverse repos; assume none held by institutions inside selected bank perimeter
fed.Q_lock: Unidentified miscellaneous liabilities, grossed negative float and net IMF reserve position
fed.Q_G: Zero eligible redeemable Treasury claims beyond T; Treasury capital investment is not silently treated as a repayable deposit
fed.currency: C_H and C_B follow the L.109 monetary-authority presentation; separate Treasury-issued currency is outside this projected currency perimeter. T uses its complete federal checkable-deposit group, including the small Treasury-cash item. These conventions are not an exact banknote/coin ownership reconstruction.

public_non_debt_inventory: N_H=0 is a baseline for the protected stock: adding any fixed nonnegative opening stock and its preservation floor does not change the constructions or diagnostics. It is not an estimate of nonbank wealth.

correction_family.bank: Reduce overstated internal asset total to issuer total, or increase internal liability total to holder total, adjust source-valued net assets accordingly, then cancel equal internal claims. End consolidated positions coincide.
correction_family.fed_2020: Use equity correction r=-9796, or raise the existing unidentified asset series by 9796 while keeping reference equity. Raw sources never change. Interpolate between endpoints only within this declared family.
correction_family.rounding: Published Fed leaf/control asset difference is -1 million in each benchmark; explicitly assigned to unidentified miscellaneous assets.

limits: Accounting-admissible conditional completions under declared eligibility, valuation, bilateral-allocation and debt-perimeter choices. The correction/allocation envelope is not an error bound over all plausible economic classifications. No quarterly series or historical witness is identified.
public_population: All actors outside the L.110 banks and Treasury/monetary-authority perimeter, including foreign banks and separately classified pension funds
monetary_authority_population: Z.1 L.109 monetary authority, mapped to the model Fed actor; not asserted to be identical to the H.4.1 legal Federal Reserve reporting perimeter.
